data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Telegram Web App JavaScript APIs on web platforms
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart interface to Telegram Web App APIs, exposing version, theme, init data and other functions. Includes mockable implementations for testing outside Telegram.
use_when: building Telegram mini‑apps with Flutter web
need to read Telegram user data or control the web app via Telegram API
avoid_when: requiring functionality outside the Telegram Web App environment
weaknesses: works only inside Telegram Web App
data.setup_notes: Add <script src="https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js" defer></script> to web/index.html and import the package
